task_description: Implement the T1-T5 local-first autonomy spec for laya-browser-mcp (rules 0.97 -> Laya default path with LLM never default; raise the escalation gate to 0.85 with OR semantics; keep escalation per-step with autonomous resume; make an unreachable LLM fall back to Laya's best guess (op != BLOCKED) so the run continues, with only Laya-BLOCKED / loop detector / destructive guard stopping a run; record source + both confidences + inference ms per step and a % fully-autonomous summary). Also clear temporary files, download+load+test the real Laya model on-device (no fakes), pick the best model on measured evidence if the web-agent underperforms, broaden the benchmark to real-world-shaped tasks, and document everything with an easy organised README setup and an honest PLAN ledger. Verify with real command output; keep the offline stub suite green with no weights and gate real-weights work behind LAYA_MODEL_DIR.
